description: Agent-driven workflow for operating the world model blueprint from programme intake through deployment and governance.
name: world-model-blueprint-agent-workflow

stages.instruction: Turn the autonomy objective and supplied evidence into a precise programme intake, model-surface decision, missing-evidence map, and downstream routing plan.
stages.name: Programme intake and evidence strategy

stages.instruction: Design the governed real, simulated, and synthetic data factory, including curation, captioning, annotation, split policy, quality gates, and permitted-use controls.
stages.name: World model data factory

stages.instruction: Route neural reconstruction, Content Agents enrichment, OVRTX headless rendering, CAD-to-SimReady conversion, harvested objects, video augmentation, and asset generation to the correct NVIDIA/skills or OVRTX capability with NIM or service-surface decisions, validation gates, and SimReady or data-factory handoff.
stages.name: Neural reconstruction and asset creation

stages.instruction: Identify the business-critical physical differentiators that must become OpenUSD or SimReady assets and define validation, scenario, and synthetic-data requirements and generate them.
stages.name: SimReady asset and scenario pipeline

stages.instruction: Translate the evidence plan into a Cosmos-class post-training plan, including base model surface, recipe, execution lane, checkpoint policy, and evaluation handoff.
stages.name: Cosmos-class post-training

stages.instruction: Route pilot, large, and massive jobs across Brev, B200 Slurm, Megatron, OSMO, Kubernetes, Ray, and local execution with explicit launch and secret-handling controls.
stages.name: Infrastructure orchestration

stages.instruction: Choose the inference path and acceleration controls, including NIM, framework inference, Dynamo, FlashDreams, vLLM, Transformers, cache policy, precision, graph capture, and rollback.
stages.name: Real-time and batch inference

stages.instruction: Define evaluation, promotion, safety, regression, failure-review, and model-comparison gates for simulator, shadow, advisory, and production stages.
stages.name: Evaluation and safety promotion

stages.instruction: Connect the model to simulator and real-system integration lanes with service ownership, observability, access control, incident handling, and rollback.
stages.name: Deployment operations

stages.instruction: Create the governance and provenance record for rights, privacy, export control, retention, access, approval gates, and risk acceptance.
stages.name: Governance and provenance
